profile: A calm nature documentary narrator, wise and warm
persona: A calm nature documentary narrator, wise and warm

lines.text: Every river starts as something that couldn't hold on.
It never knows the way. It only knows down.
Mountains, forests, fields. It touches everything and keeps nothing.
When the land splits it, it doesn't argue. It goes both ways.
And at the end, it simply stops being a river.
It becomes the sky. Then, one day, the snow again.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
